scope: Explicit syllable-level follow-up, uai/iau/ɛn/ən/ui screening guards, and separation of early/undated loans from modern loans.
limits: The graph remains outside the repository.
Unreviewed hot cells are retrieval leads, not loan classifications.
Grammatical liao is excluded; lexical 完了 and 不得了 are explicit exceptions.
For ui, possible native stem + i must be checked separately; no blanket rime-based loan rule is applied.
The rare donor character 㩆 is retained. Unresolved donor characters and varieties remain unresolved.
